QUOTE: "A stale process reads live data correctly but runs old logic when it writes."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the code-axis asymmetry: reads stay current, while a stale process writes old logic. Its later line that a build through a stale process would drop pipeline layers supports this. It omits the "opens the database per call" reason, but that reason isn't needed for the substance.
